slot_scores.name: max_distance_800m
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does every residential area code (A through L) need to be covered by at least one chain store within its 800 m radius?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether every residential area must be within the 800 m radius of a built store, directly covering the coverage radius / maximum distance hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The single P0 hidden slot (coverage radius of 800 m) was explicitly confirmed before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL, so stopping after that point was appropriate.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions about store placement and, critically, explicitly confirmed the 800 m coverage requirement before modeling. The only hidden P0 slot was resolved, and the agent stopped appropriately with no silent assumptions on that fact.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
